name: Corentine Lauria
original_name: コレンティーヌ＝ローリア
source:
She is the second princess of the Kingdom of Lauria, a major power in the central plains.

Not wanting to be a princess who is simply protected, she has honed her martial arts skills since childhood, and her skills are said to rival those of the leader of Lauria's knights. 

She has a very earnest personality, and is unsociable and strict.
She was almost married to the prince of Cherubim as a political marriage, but due to the treatment of Tiliana, the two ended up fleeing together.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1350333]Getchu[/url]]
